valuation_template_rationale: Current filing, release, diluted-share-count, cash and debt evidence support an earnings multiple; scenarios normalize adjusted EPS for acquisition amortization, stock compensation, debt-funded growth and contract-estimate risk.
bear_assumptions: The USD 16.70 adjusted-EPS guidance midpoint receives a 25x multiple as backlog conversion normalizes and acquisition funding, leverage, labor, percentage-of-completion estimates, fixed-price contracts and goodwill compress the premium.
base_assumptions: The USD 16.70 adjusted-EPS guidance midpoint receives a 32x multiple as record RPO and backlog convert with sustained segment margins, while adjusted-earnings, acquisition and execution risks retain a material discount to the current multiple.
bull_assumptions: The USD 16.70 adjusted-EPS guidance midpoint receives a 40x multiple as strong grid, generation and mission-critical demand sustains record organic growth, margins, backlog conversion and cash generation despite acquisition integration.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark clears required confidence-adjusted expected return, base upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, and margin-of-safety gates while backlog quality, margins, cash conversion, acquisitions and leverage remain supported; downgrade if backlog or RPO contracts without conversion, margins deteriorate, project losses or collection problems rise, free cash flow misses guidance, leverage increases without commensurate earnings, covenant headroom erodes, or projects are cancelled or deferred.
